sources.claim: Accepted representation, fit/apply, family, clinical ownership and common-result settlement.
R core plus Python was explicitly approved; older fleet overrides are now superseded by the user.
Prior independent review settled scientific semantics; it is not an independent audit of this new kit.
A/B/C/D drafts plus clinical and target extensions retain full historical scope; v2 normalizes accepted decisions.
Original architecture, no raw processing, reusable block count, clinical/target goals and historical constraints.
Linear-model omics framework; official release installation uses R 4.6. Metadata is not a complete installed lock.
Count-dependent variance modeling on top of limma for quantified proteomics.
Provides multivariate integration/classification/regression; release-family installation is not equivalent to package minimum R.

sources.claim: Fit/predict/outcome/missingness semantics must be qualified per method, rather than an unconditional complete-matrix rule.
Probabilistic multi-omics factor model with training/downstream interfaces and Python bridge dependencies.
Missing values can be accommodated in model likelihood; factor structure/variance is exploratory, not guaranteed biological interpretation.
Article abstract reports FCN3-related drug-binding studies by SPR. Compound-specific raw sensorgrams and numerical Kd were not reviewed in this task.
Academic website access is not blanket commercial/service/redistribution permission. Operation-specific entitlement is required.
API academic-use restriction and rate ceiling require adapter policy; do not assume an unrestricted public database.
Current terms distinguish CC0 data, attribution-governed artwork and software-specific licenses/exceptions; old news summaries cannot license all assets.
Quantification/normalization should specify standards, sample amount, units and relative-normalization basis; no universal mandatory within-class closure.
Host agent model/effort configuration and inheritance matter; per-account effective availability still requires runtime discovery.
Use a coherent supported R/Bioconductor release; verify actual package installation rather than inferring environment from a language floor.
